g.title: Reach: the paint that takes its livery from this artboard. Where a graphic crosses this line it must meet the next artboard.
Glass outlines: glass never takes livery.
Light outlines: lights never take livery.
Wheel outlines: wheels never take livery.
Feature lines: beltline, shoulder and sill.

path.title: Beltline: the bottom edge of the glass.
Shoulder: the top edge of the reach.
Sill: the bottom edge of the reach.

g.title: Wheel centres: the centre of each wheel's outline, in artboard millimetres.
